contracts.boundary: dependency-cruiser graph over the shipped root modules, including an isolated fixture with a stubbed Pi package
contracts.assertions: A runtime host-SDK import from router.ts is reported as router-no-runtime-host-sdk; the committed type-only import is accepted; removing the type-only allowance turns the accepted fixture red; findings carry rule, file, and edge; a missing tool is reported as unavailable with an install hint instead of a pass.

boundaryTest.name: rejects a runtime host-SDK import in the resolve-only router and accepts the type-only form

invariant.name: projects dependency-cruiser violations with rule and edge

fault.name: the type-only allowance is load-bearing: removing it turns the passing fixture red

contracts.boundary: committed ast-grep rule fixtures plus the shared runner's parsing of Knip, Semgrep, actionlint, gitleaks, and OSV output
contracts.assertions: All committed ast-grep rules pass four valid/invalid fixture suites; every Knip issue kind flattens to a finding; absent external tools produce exit code 2 and an install hint; the workflow runs architecture, dead-code, and structural checks on pull requests.

boundaryTest.name: the committed ast-grep rules pass their own valid and invalid fixtures

invariant.name: parses every Knip issue kind into one flat finding list

fault.name: reports unavailable tools with install hints instead of a false pass
